FN-5VC4F3M-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 405
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Blackshear
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/31/2025
House Bill 405 as introduced would extend the current supplemental privilege assessment, the
secondary supplemental privilege assessment, and the monthly surcharge on nursing home beds
that is currently set to expire on August 31, 2025 to August 31, 2028. In fiscal year 2024, after
deducting the costs of collection, these nursing home bed taxes generated approximately $113
million for the Alabama Medicaid Agency. The Alabama Medicaid Agency estimates $114
million will be collected in fiscal year 2025 from these assessments.

Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/23/2025

surcharge on nursing home beds that is currently set to expire on August 31, 2025 to August 31,
2028. In fiscal year 2024, after deducting the costs of collection, these nursing home bed taxes
generated approximately $113 million for the Alabama Medicaid Agency. The Alabama
